gloss: closing up shop; closing down a business

definitions.gloss: closing up shop (for the day); closing down a business (for good)
definitions.explanation: Shutting a shop at the end of the day, or closing it permanently. Also used figuratively for winding up any activity.

examples.japanese: ⟦そろそろ→そろそろ：01259_sorosoro⟧{店|みせ}じまいだ。

examples.english: No customers came because of the rain, so we closed up early.

examples.japanese: {五十年|ごじゅうねん}⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{本屋|ほんや}→本屋：03034_honya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今月|こんげつ}{末|まつ}→今月末：28384_kongetsumatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{店|みせ}じまい⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: The bookstore that has stood in the shopping street for fifty years is closing down at the end of this month.

notes:
From ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧ (shop) + {仕舞|しま}い (closing, ending), with rendaku to じまい; also written {店仕舞|みせじま}い. Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{店|みせ}じまい⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to close up early
- {店|みせ}じまい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: closing time
- {店|みせ}じまい⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: closing-down sale

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{閉店|へいてん}→閉店：09698_heiten⟧: closing (for the day or for good) — the standard word on signs
- ⟦{廃業|はいぎょう}→廃業：20645_haigyou⟧: going out of business — formal, for any business
